Teaching Assistant

CE-ENGIN 214: Programming for Civil Engineers (Python)
University of Massachusetts Amherst · September 2024–January 2025

  • Designed homework assignments and exam problems for undergraduate Python programming.
  • Taught and led programming labs, guiding students through code implementation and debugging.
  • Graded assignments with feedback and held regular office hours on programming concepts and engineering applications.

麻省大学阿默斯特分校 (UMass Amherst) · 2024 年 9 月—2025 年 1 月

  • 设计面向本科生的 Python 编程作业与考试题目。
  • 讲授并指导编程实验课，带领学生完成代码实现与调试。
  • 批改作业并提供反馈，定期开展课后答疑，帮助学生掌握编程概念与工程应用。
